Under legacy semantics, both `"auto"` and `"multiindex"` make `SnapshotWindow.build` retain the build snapshots unchanged as both `network_index` and `model_index`. `solve_model` passes that stored `model_index` to `extra_functionality`, so it supplies the model’s build snapshots in the network’s own labelling, including when the model uses only a subset of snapshots.
